name: deepstack-ui
description: UI for working with Deepstack. Allows uploading an image and performing object detection or face recognition with Deepstack. Also faces can be registered with Deepstack. The effect of various parameters can be explored, including filtering objects by confidence, type and location in the image. Created by robmarkcole. *I am not the creator or maintainer of this container I am merely providing the Unraid template.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: For access to the Web UI. Default is 8501.

variables.name: Deepstack IP
variables.description: The IP address of your Deepstack instance. Default is localhost.

variables.name: Deepstack Port
variables.description: The PORT of your Deepstack instance. Default is 80.

variables.name: Deepstack API Key
variables.description: The API key of your Deepstack instance, if you have set one.

variables.name: Deepstack Timeout
variables.description: The timeout to wait for Deepstack. Default is 10 seconds.

variables.name: Deepstack Custom Model
variables.description: The name of a custom model, if you wish to use one.

variables.name: Deepstack UI Debug Mode
variables.description: Lowers the minimum confidence threshold to 1%. Default is False.
